A.text: Patients with craniofacial anomalies need dental care across their lifespan, both because of the condition and as part of treatment.
A pediatric dentist on the team is ideal because these patients' exam and restorative needs often differ from standard periodicity.

B.text: Dental needs persist across the lifespan, so care does not stop when the surgical phase ends.

C.text: Cleft lip rehabilitation can take years of specialized team treatment, so it is not brief.
